_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1). Companion phrase pack: phrases/rock/. Source: docs/idiom-research/genre-rock-pop.md section A. GM programs 0-based. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Rock
blurb: Classic riff rock: a straight-8 downstroke power-chord wall, a driving pick-bass root lock, and blue-note pentatonic riffs with room to ring.

flavors.label: Arena Riff
flavors.blurb: Stadium downstrokes on plain power chords -- the four-chord wall everybody already knows.

flavors.label: One-Chord Riff
flavors.blurb: No changes at all: everything nails itself to one pedal and the riff does the talking.

flavors.label: Boogie Shuffle
flavors.blurb: I-IV-V on dominant sevenths with the pick dragging behind the beat -- bar-band twelve-bar.

flavors.label: Power Ballad
flavors.blurb: Chords ring out instead of chugging, and the harmony moves twice as often underneath.

flavors.label: Dorian Jam
flavors.blurb: Minor seventh vamp with a bright natural sixth -- loose, modal, made for soloing over.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Rock harmony is guitar-shaped and modal, not functional. Live in the aeolian and mixolydian pocket: I-bVII-IV, i-bVI-bVII, I-IV-V with dominant 7ths when it turns bluesy. Power chords hide the third, so major/minor mixture is fair game. Favour two bars per chord, riffs over a pedal, and plain triads.
